Document type
A visa is an entry permission issued by a consulate or, increasingly, as a PDF. It is not a document you carry on its own and it only means anything inside a passport.

Buy a Visa via Telegram: how the transaction works

Most Finnish visa sellers work through a channel that posts stock and a chat that closes the sale. The channel is marketing. The chat is where you find out whether the person knows the document.

Keep the photos the seller sends. When the parcel arrives, photograph the unopened envelope before you open it, then the document beside the envelope. That sequence ties the document to the seller.

Who actually issues a Visa

The Finnish visa is a state product made by a Finnish embassy. Replicas copy the look, registered originals carry a number in the office records, and both are sold on Telegram as if they were the same thing.

Number formats are the one part of this that a buyer can always test without equipment. Look up the format for Finland and compare digit by digit. It takes a minute and settles most arguments.

Replica or registered original

If the card only has to look right across a counter, a print is enough and the bottom of the band is fair. If a number has to be looked up, pay the top and make the seller prove the lookup first.

This is the single most useful distinction on the page, because it explains the price spread better than anything else. A quote tells you which tier the seller thinks you are in.

What a fair price looks like

Price is the easiest thing to compare and the least informative. Two adverts at the same figure can differ completely in stock, number and delivery, and the figure shows you none of it.

The table below splits the band into the three tiers so you can see what each figure is actually for. Read it before you open a chat and you will not anchor on whatever number the seller opens with.

The buying process, step by step

The steps below are deliberately boring. Boring is what a Finnish visa purchase should feel like.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is a Finnish embassy.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format a Finnish embassy uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 140–500 EUR band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

These are the tests that matter for a Finnish visa. The two local ones are worth memorising.

  • Check the licence for the EU layout and confirm the Traficom reference on the card.
  • Confirm the passport lion printing and the personal identity code control character.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for a Finnish embassy. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

Red flags specific to Finland, plus the generic tells that apply anywhere.

  • An identity card with an identity code that has no control character.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a visa cost on Telegram?

Between 150 and 850 US dollars. Stickers sit higher than PDFs, and a sticker with a resolving number sits at the top.

Do I need the passport as well?

Yes. A visa alone proves nothing because it has to sit in a passport with a matching number.

Are PDF visas real documents?

They are real permissions, but as files they are trivially edited. Treat the number, not the file, as the thing to check.

What should the seller show me?

The sticker edge and the passport number field, plus the issuing post. If the post is unnamed, walk away.

Can a visa number be checked?

Against the consular system only, and usually only by the holder. Ask for the appointment receipt as corroboration.

Before you pay

Start with the authority and the number, then work outward. The contact page is open if you want a second pair of eyes.
